title: Negotiated Deals
text: Negotiated Deals Sep 18, 1998| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIASECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENTMittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor,224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMDRP/Policy Circular-21/98September 18, 1998 To The Executive Directors, Managing Directorsof all the Exchanges, Sir, Sub: Negotiated Deals Ref: Our circular no. SMDRP/ Policy/ Circulars- 20/98 dated August 04, 1998 With reference to the above it is advised that the Exchanges are to make suitable changes in the system software so as to abide by the rules/guidelines as mentioned in our aforesaid circular. The guidelines listed in the circular should be implemented not later than August 17, 1998.(i.e. the provisions of the circular should be implemented for all settlements commencing from August 17, 1998) The Exchanges are requested to communicate the status of the implementation of this circular in the Monthly Development Report. Thanking you Yours faithfully P K BindlishDivision ChiefSecondary Market, DepositoryResearch & Publications DepartmentE-mail : @ sebiho.ernet.in Encl: as above
